title: ASGS Edition 3, 2021 state and territory generalised boundaries
method: Request codes 1–8; Other Territories excluded because hospital table has eight named states/territories.
Request WGS84 longitude/latitude, maximum allowable offset 0.025 degrees, geometry precision 3.
Retain original response; map state codes to BITRE abbreviations.
Omit tiny/degenerate exterior or hole rings with absolute planar area below 0.0005 square degrees for this national-scale display.
Orient retained polygon rings for D3 spherical rendering; no hospital measures changed.
Use this geographic outline for the full 2011–2021 series; it is not a historical boundary-change analysis.
